en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a curved electric tramway line running through a semi-rural, tree-lined area. There is a small building on the left with a few people standing outside near a fence and tram tracks in the foreground that lead toward a tramcar visible on the right. Overhead power lines and poles run along the tracks. The caption at the bottom reads in Dutch, indicating the scene is in Nijmegen, Netherlands.
